heading: You already have an account
body_html:
Hello {guest_first_name},

someone – probably you – just tried to register with this email address, but an account already exists for it.

{cta_button}

Forgot your password? Choose a new password.

If this was not you, you can ignore this email: your account has not been changed.

Kind regards,
{business_name}
